violations.description: POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of kolaches was noted not being properly dated for disposition in the walk in cooler and walk in freezer.
CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food noted not properly labeled. It was noted that kolaches and ''old dough'' was not labeled in the walk in cooler.
SINGLE - USE/SINGLE - SERVICE ARTICLES (1 pts): Single service items articles noted made of unapproved materials. Observed trays of kolaches cover with kitchen garbage liners.
IN-USE UTENSILS (1 pts): In - use utensils noted not stored on a clean surface. Observed in-use utensils being stored between butcher block work table and the wall.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Walk-in cooler walls noted debris build up behind wire racking.

HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Soap was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory near the dish washing area. A waste receptacle was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory near the dish washing area.
CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food noted not properly labeled. Employee food items in walk in cooler are not properly identified to diferentiate from establishment food items and ingredients.
CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food items on sheet pans noted being stored and covered in a non-food grade bag in walk-in cooler.
